# Third-Party Hardware Assets

Do not place externally sourced CAD or printable files here without confirming
that redistribution is permitted.

For every third-party asset, record:

- original file and component name;
- author or manufacturer;
- source URL;
- original licence;
- date accessed;
- modifications made for this robot;
- assembly in which it is used.

Third-party assets retain their original licences and are not automatically
covered by the repository's hardware licence.
